responsibility: This target configuration header defines the MIPS SDE environment’s driver, assembler, linker, ABI, and runtime conventions. It normalizes command-line options by inferring ISA, ABI, FP mode, and endianness for multilib selection, changes assembler behavior to prefer trap and suppress implicit MIPS16 assembly mode, sets linker emulations, chooses unsigned char and long-based size types, customizes exception-return and epilogue temporaries, and forces non-MIPS16 .init/.fini call sequences, making it the main OS/runtime policy layer for SDE toolchains.
same_name_distinction: Compared with sde.opt, this header is the substantive SDE subtarget policy layer: it overrides driver, assembler, linker, ABI, type-size, EH-return, and .init/.fini conventions through target macros and specs, whereas sde.opt only adds command-line option aliases.
